strategyDescription: PRs sorted by number are split into chunks of 8; one model call per chunk partitions that chunk into local groups (2+ PRs) and outliers; one reduce call merges local group descriptors (label+summary only, no PR lists) into global themes. TypeScript expands themes back to PR numbers and validates the partition, ranking and coverage.
noveltyRationale: Prior model strategies used per-PR facets with a closed vocabulary or pairwise edge verification with connected components. This one decomposes by corpus chunk and merges at the level of group descriptors in a model reduce step; membership is never judged across chunks per PR or pair, and no lexical candidate generation or fixed vocabulary is used.
validation: 35 unique PRs covered once; all numbers known; cluster ids unique; sizes match; ranking by size desc then id asc; window matches corpus

Chunking by PR number puts related PRs in different chunks; cross-chunk merging relies only on group labels, so 9 PRs ended unclassified as chunk outliers. A reduce that sees outliers too would likely help.
